summary: Warner Music Group filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026 disclosing that subsidiary Warner Music Inc. entered a September 24, 2026 employment agreement with director Valentin Blavatnik to serve as Managing Director, Warner Recorded Music, North America and UK, and Corporate Development, effective September 25, 2026. Terms include $600,000 annual base salary, at-will employment, 120-day resignation notice, severance of at least base salary for qualifying terminations, and restrictive covenants; incentive compensation discussions are contemplated for fiscal 2028. This is a routine executive-hiring disclosure, not a special situation, though Blavatnik's Access Industries ties merit governance monitoring.
